spanish: Y toda minjá de sacerdote entera será; no será comida.

findings.issue: minjá leaves the common noun untranslated; common nouns stay Spanish.
Masculine adjective is rendered feminine entera so the predicate agrees with the 3fs subject.

notes: Y, toda, de sacerdote, será, no, and passive será comida match the conjunction, כל, the construct, qal 3fs, the negative, and niphal 3fs.
